title: Temporal Leakage Distorts the TGB Node Affinity Leaderboard: A Point-in-Time Audit
abstract: arXiv:2611.30289v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Node affinity prediction in the Temporal Graph Benchmark (TGB) asks how a node's future interactions will be distributed over other nodes. On this task, methods that reuse past ground-truth labels often outperform temporal graph neural networks, and the state of the art builds on them. Such comparisons assume a point-in-time correct evaluation, in which a model receives only information available at prediction time. Drawing on as-of joins and bitemporal databases, we formalize this requirement by distinguishing when a label must be predicted, its query time, from when it is fully determined, its availability time, and we audit the four TGB node affinity datasets and their evaluation loop with model-agnostic tools. None of the four meets it. translated_title: 时间泄漏扭曲了TGB节点亲和性排行榜：一项时间点审计
translated_abstract: 时序图基准中的节点亲和性预测任务关注的是一个节点未来的交互将如何在其他节点上分布。在这项任务上，复用过去真实标签的方法往往优于时序图神经网络，而当前最先进的方法正是建立在这些方法之上的。这类比较默认了一种“时间点正确”的评估方式，即模型在预测时只能获得当时可用的信息。借鉴“as-of 连接”与双时态数据库的概念，我们通过区分标签必须被预测的时间（查询时间）与标签被完全确定的时间（可用时间），将这一要求形式化，并使用与模型无关的工具对四个 TGB 节点亲和性数据集及其评估流程进行了审计。结果表明，四个数据集无一满足该要求。在三个数据集上，每个标签汇总的其实是其时间戳约五天后的某一天的数据，而非文档中所述的随后一周，但评估流程却在该时间戳之后立即将其反馈给模型；在第四个数据集上，……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文借鉴双时态数据库概念形式化了“时间点正确”的评估要求，并审计发现 TGB 全部四个节点亲和性数据集都存在时间泄漏——标签在其可用时间之前就被反馈给模型，从而不公平地偏向复用过去标签的方法并扭曲了排行榜。
en_tdlr: This paper formalizes point-in-time correct evaluation using as-of joins and bitemporal database concepts, and audits all four TGB node affinity datasets, revealing that temporal leakage—labels fed back before their availability time—distorts the leaderboard in favor of label-reusing methods over temporal graph neural networks.
